thread:
Alice Nguyen: :rotating_light: seeing surge of 400s from embeddings endpoint (POST /v1/embeddings). Started ~10:02 UTC, lots of support tickets coming in.
Ben Patel: what's the error payload? 400 or 500?
Alice Nguyen: mix — majority 400 with 'dimension mismatch', but we also have elevated 502/504s from a couple of GPU nodes. Logs pasted below.
Carla Romero: grabbing logs now. If it's dimension mismatch we likely have a mismatch between client request shape and model config after the last embedding change.
Dave Li: I'm on-call infra. Which model is affected? rw-embed-1?
Alice Nguyen: yes, rw-embed-1 and the quant variant rw-embed-1-q. Error from proxy: 
``` 
ERROR api.embedding: request validation failed: expected dims=1536, got dims=128
client_id=acct_9XJ.. user_id=team-x
route=/v1/embeddings model=rw-embed-1 batch_id=0
stacktrace=...
```
Ben Patel: that `expected dims=1536` is new — did we change the default dimension in the model registry in last deploy? I remember a PR touching embed model mapping.
Carla Romero: PR #5421 touched model-metadata — might've set dims for rw-embed-1 incorrectly. Checking.
InfraBot: deploy v2.14.4 started at 2026-11-14T09:58:12Z; services impacted: embed-gateway, embed-workers.
Alice Nguyen: hmm deploy time lines up with incident start. Can someone pin the commit?
Ben Patel: commit 8c3b2ee changed model metadata: rw-embed-1 dims=1536 -> 1536 (no change) but rw-embed-legacy was deprecated. Wait there's a later PR that added auto-upgrade logic for client payload normalization (PR #5479).
Carla Romero: PR #5479 merged 11:57Z — it attempted to pad/truncate incoming vectors to match model dims. Could be the pad logic failing for batched requests.
Dave Li: I'm seeing memory OOMs on worker-23 and worker-17 around the same time as 502s. Batching config recently increased from max_batch=64 to 128 in v2.14.4.
Alice Nguyen: so two simultaneous changes: padding logic + larger batches. Large batches + incorrect pad could blow GPU memory and then proxy returns 502/504. The 400s are clients sending 128-dim embeddings to an endpoint expecting 1536.
Ben Patel: reproduction steps from one customer attached to a support case: 
``` 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-embed-1","input":["..."],"vector_dim":128}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 128"}
Carla Romero: ok I can repro locally with a minimal script that sends mixed-dim vectors in the same batch. The pad/truncate code assumed uniform dims within a batch; if we get mixed dims it corrupts internal buffers.
Alice Nguyen: mitigation options: 1) rollback v2.14.4 to v2.14.3 (reverts both batch size and pad logic), 2) push a hotfix to validate client dims earlier and return a clean 400, 3) enforce per-request single-dim and reject mixed-dim batches at gateway with clear message.
Dave Li: rolling back will restore stability fast. Hotfix might take longer to test. I'm leaning rollback + follow-up fix.
Ben Patel: agreed — rollback to v2.14.3 now, then we can deploy a targeted fix that rejects mixed-dim batches and adds explicit error text.
InfraBot: rollback initiated for services: embed-gateway, embed-workers at 10:15 UTC by Dave Li (action rollback v2.14.3).
Alice Nguyen: sending customer comms templates to support. SupportBot: auto-queued 18 open tickets to priority queue.
Carla Romero: after rollback I still see some 400s but much reduced. 502s dropped to baseline.
Dave Li: rollback completed at 10:20 UTC. infra metrics: request error rate down 86% in 5m.
Ben Patel: good. For the follow-up fix: I propose gate 1) explicit check at gateway for batch uniformity, 2) if mixed dims -> return 400 with body `{"error":"batch dimension mismatch: all vectors must be of same dim; got [128,1536]"}` and 3) add telemetry counters. Also add an integration test for mixed-dim batches.
Carla Romero: also we should cap max_batch to 64 until we validate memory behavior under real traffic. Reverting the batch size increase separately avoids surprising OOMs.
Alice Nguyen: agree. Can we get a patch for the gateway check + tests? Ben?
Ben Patel: I'll prepare patch branch `fix/embed-dim-guard` and open PR. Plan: gateway validation + unit tests + e2e repro test harness. ETA ~2 hours.
Carla Romero: I'll own reducing max_batch in config and prepare a canary deploy. Dave, can you push the config change across clusters?
Dave Li: will push config change: set `max_batch`=64 in embed-workers group and add circuit-breaker: `max_memory_util=80%` to avoid OOM. Pushing at 10:45 UTC.
InfraBot: config update applied to embed-workers in prod at 10:47 UTC by Dave Li.
Alice Nguyen: support updates: message to affected customers saying we rolled back a deploy and are deploying a validation patch; apologies for short-term disruption. Template shared in #support-private.
SupportBot: posted updates to 19 affected customers.
Ben Patel: PR opened: #5510 — contains gateway guard + tests. Requesting review from Carla and Alice.
Carla Romero: reviewing now. Also adding a small logging improvement to include `client_batch_dims` for quicker triage.
Alice Nguyen: after rollback and config changes error rates are back to normal. Any lingering errors?
Dave Li: we still see a small tail of 400s from old client libraries that include `vector_dim` in the payload incorrectly. We should add an expired-client-mapper that translates known legacy params to the new format or strongly document and version bump the client.
Ben Patel: good point. For now gateway will respond with a clear error and include a link to migration doc. I'll add that to PR.
Carla Romero: merging PR after tests pass. Also scheduling a postmortem meeting: root cause = concurrent deploy of padding change + increased batch size without adequate e2e memory testing; contributing factor = mixed-dim batch behavior not validated by tests.
Alice Nguyen: postmortem owner: Carla Romero. Action items: 1) add e2e memory test harness for embeddings (owner: Dave), 2) strict validation at gateway (Ben), 3) rollback playbook improvement (Alice), 4) customer comms template for embedding incidents (Support).
Dave Li: all done — monitoring dashboards updated and alert thresholds tuned to catch early spikes in worker mem and batch rejection rate.
InfraBot: release v2.14.5 (patch) scheduled at 13:10 UTC — includes dim guard + docs link.
Ben Patel: PR merged at 11:50 UTC, patch built and staged. Will canary at 12:30 UTC.
Alice Nguyen: marking incident as resolved pending canary. Final status: rollback performed, config tuned, patch merged. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
SupportBot: tagging all affected tickets as \"resolved - rollback & patch in progress\".
Carla Romero: note for postmortem: consider automated runbook that simulates mixed-dim batches and memory pressure. Might catch similar issues in future.
Ben Patel: thanks everyone — nice coordinated response.
Alice Nguyen: :thumbsup: closing incident thread. Will upload postmortem and timeline to /incidents/postmortems after meeting.
